SYSTEM INGESTION ARCHITECTURE

How antAI Intercepts Audio Fraud

The step-by-step telemetry loop: from the initial WebRTC read-only stream tap to parallelized GPU inference, LangGraph dead-zone fusion, and in-flight action hold enforcement.

01

Media Ingress & Stream Tap

STAGE #1 OF 5
LATENCY SLA: < 40 ms

Read-only fork from Android WebRTC SFU / CallScreening tap.

Media frames flow through the server relay. A non-blocking tap forks 16kHz mono PCM chunks into memory queues without degrading call jitter or affecting codec negotiation.

[INGRESS] Android WebRTC PeerConnection → SFU Media Relay → Read-only Audio Ingestor Tap [16kHz mono float32]
02

Silero VAD Speech Segmentation

STAGE #2 OF 5
LATENCY SLA: 15–30 ms

0.4–2.0s voiced speech slice extraction and silence eviction.

Voiced audio segments are stripped of acoustic silence. Concurrent workers pass speech slices into streaming ASR and acoustic deepfake pipelines simultaneously.

[BUFFER] AudioIngestor → Silero VAD (0.4–2.0s speech slices) → Streaming ASR Worker (Deepgram / Whisper)
03

14-Model Multi-Modal Evaluation

STAGE #3 OF 5
LATENCY SLA: 120–220 ms

Parallelized acoustic, biometric, semantic, and facial models.

Concurrent inference: AST + wav2vec2 synthetic probability, ECAPA-TDNN speaker similarity, scam pattern NLP classifier, psychological urgency scorer, and lip-sync AV correlation.

[FAN-OUT] Parallel Inference: [AST-ASVspoof5 (95M) | wav2vec2-large | ECAPA-TDNN 192-dim | MiniLM NLP | SyncNet]
04

Deterministic LangGraph Fusion

STAGE #4 OF 5
LATENCY SLA: < 10 ms

Hard/soft signal partitioning and corroboration verification.

Zero black-box guesses: hard signals (identity mismatch, high deepfake prob) add up to +60. Soft signals require at least 2 independent corroborations to clear verify (capped at 39 if solo).

[FUSION] LangGraph DAG: Hard (+60 max) + Soft (+22) dead-zone ramps → Corroboration Guard (Cap @ 39 if uncorroborated)
05

Forensic Reasoning & Hold Directive

STAGE #5 OF 5
LATENCY SLA: 180–350 ms

Synthesized 'why' verdict + WebSocket hold push to client.

Fast-path template or Groq/Gemini/local Qwen fallback generates natural-language guidance in English and Hindi, while the Intercept Controller halts high-risk in-app actions.

[MITIGATION] Decision Node → (Risk ≥ 70 + Money Ask) → HOLD DIRECTIVE DISPATCH → LLM Explainer
